scope: Proposition 4.4 (Absolute-overlap locking) of the manuscript “Stretched-exponential barriers for typical SK initial states” (preprints/Stretched-exponential-barriers-for-typical-SK-initial-states-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 227 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 7bc4d5a64b6465fe), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 30. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every fixed h ∈ (0, 1) there is b > 0 such that, for all sufficiently large n, Eπ⊗3 { |R(x, y)| ≥ h, |R(v, x)|, |R(v, y)| ≤ b, ⏐ ⏐|R(v, x)| − |R(v, y)| ⏐ ⏐ > 2n−1/100 } ≤ exp(−n9/10 ). (4.21) The same conclusion holds after decreasing b.
